scripts.db:setup: cd server && go run ./cmd/household-api bootstrap && go run ./cmd/household-api migrate
scripts.gen: turbo run gen && pnpm run gen:design && pnpm run gen:go
scripts.gen:design: pnpm --filter @household/tokens run css && pnpm --filter @household/icons run vendor
scripts.gen:go: cd server && go generate ./... && go test -count=1 -run TestTheClientRegistriesAreTheGeneratedOnes ./internal/syncconfig -args -write
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:ts && pnpm run lint:css && pnpm run lint:go && pnpm run lint:api && pnpm run format:check
scripts.lint:go: cd server && go tool -modfile=tools/golangci-lint.mod golangci-lint run
scripts.test: turbo run test && pnpm run test:go
scripts.secrets: cd server && go tool -modfile=tools/gitleaks.mod gitleaks git --redact --no-banner --verbose ..
scripts.format: prettier --write . && cd server && go tool -modfile=tools/golangci-lint.mod golangci-lint fmt
